Pattern evidence participates in canonical M10 candidate direction and native setup competition; breakout candidates continue through the existing confirmation, timing, direction-exclusivity, risk, broker-stop and execution gates. Customer download filename is XauCloud.io.ex5. Fixes Outlook SIGNAL_EXPIRED false skips caused by aging the local execution window from the original server generation timestamp; the EA now preserves that timestamp for audit while measuring the armed execution expiry from local approval time.
